text: elaine: Dropped a tiny spike: charts PR that changes axis unit behavior and adds an "annotation priority" so alerts stick above smoothing overlays. Need quick design + a11y sanity check. rory: Nice. Two quick concerns: axis units right now switch to decimals for small numbers (0.00012). Suggest using micro/milli suffixes instead and round to 2 significant digits. vishal: Agreed. Also the annotation priority is important: when smoothing is on the band sits above the line which hides markers. We should render annotations and sentinels above smoothing and tooltips. elaine: I made annotation z-index highest in the mock. Also added a tiny badge on the axis when units auto-switch so users know what unit is active. Example label: "Units: auto (ms)" with a tooltip. a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: unit badge must have aria-label e.g. "Units auto: milliseconds" and be keyboard focusable. Annotations must be reachable via keyboard and announced via aria-live when focused. Avoid relying on color alone for sentinel markers. rory: Legend update: when space is constrained hide the value but keep the color swatch + abbreviated name; tooltip provides full name and latest raw value. Make sure abbreviation isn't ambiguous; use heuristics to keep first 2 meaningful chars + numeric suffix if duplicates. vishal: Implementation detail: expose `displayUnit` and `nativeUnit` on the chart model and a `annotationPriority` flag. We'll also add `rawIndices` for accurate sentinel mapping. For perf, compose the annotation layer to avoid paint storms. qa-jun: QA note: test cases should include tabs with smoothing on/off, unit auto-switch at magnitude boundaries, keyboard navigation to annotation markers, and scenarios with >6 sentinels where we collapse to a legend badge. a11y-bot: Suggested live region example for docs: Sparkline (auth latency): min 2ms, median 10ms, max 420ms. 2 sentinels above 95%. a11y-bot: Also ensure markers have a 24px hit target with visually small 4px dot + halo, and add `aria-describedby` with the timestamp and raw value. elaine: Microcopy tweak: control label should read "Highlight top percentile (95%)" in the quick settings, advanced lets you pick the percentile. Also tooltip label should say "value (raw)" when overlay active. figma-bot: Updated figma with axis badge + annotation z-order :white_check_mark: rory: tiny nit: when units display badge is present, make sure it doesn't cause layout shift; use absolute positioning inside the chart header. elaine: Acceptance criteria I'll add: smart units with suffixes + 2 sig figs, unit badge with aria-label, annotations rendered above smoothing layer, markers capped at 6 with legend badge fallback, aria-live summary on focus, tooltips show raw/smoothed labels, perf note to composited annotation layer. I'll update the PR and ping. vishal: PR: added flags and rawIndices mapping. qa-jun: :thumbsup:
